usedFor: Shopify captures shoppers and Perfex CRM tracks leads, so “Abandoned Checkout” can feed “Create Lead”.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Create Lead” in Perfex CRM
bestTemplate.why: A shopper who left an email and a cart becomes a lead your team can follow up.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” is polling and “Create Lead” always adds a new lead, so repeat checkouts can duplicate leads.
